verdict.line: You lose if you feed Q into a 50+ Fury Renekton with W up; you win if you all-in only after Cull the Meek, Ruthless Predator, and Slice and Dice are all on cooldown.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a race between two cooldown-gated all-in kits, and the deciding variable is Renekton's Fury bar: below 50 Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) is just a 0.75s double-slash stun, but at 50+ it becomes a 1.5s triple-slash that destroys shields and doubles his Q (Cull the Meek) damage and heal. Irelia's W (Defiant Dance) reduces physical damage taken while charging, which is the direct counter to that empowered burst window if you time it right.

theirWindow.when: Fury is 50+ and W is up
theirWindow.what: His Ruthless Predator becomes a three-hit, 1.5s stun that shreds shields, and Cull the Meek's damage and heal both spike. Do not trade auto-for-auto into this state — back off and let his Fury bleed down instead.

yourWindow.when: his Q, W, and E are all on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Cull the Meek is only a 7s cooldown so it's easy to bait out, but once his W (16-8s) and Slice and Dice (16-10s) are also down he has no stun and no gap-closer. Stack 4 Ionian Fervor charges and dash in with Q (Bladesurge) — this is OP.GG's own read on the lane, and it's the correct one.

start.why: The 47.9% win rate, 91.6%-pick start — the sustain offsets Cull the Meek's constant AoE chip and his Fury-fueled auto trades.

boots.why: 89.2% pick, 48.8% win rate — flat physical reduction directly answers his auto-attack Fury generation and his slash-stun combos.

core.why: Current-health damage plus the slow undercuts his Slice and Dice dash-away and answers his Q lifesteal.
Part of the highest-sample core path (BORK into Hullbreaker into Death's Dance, 59.5% win rate over 195 games) and scales your side-lane duels.

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-win-rate page (48.1% over the 33.3%-pick sample) — Conqueror's stacking heal matches Irelia's extended-trade pattern and offsets Renekton's Fury-fueled sustain.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 84.3% and 48.9% win rate — Ignite punishes his Cull the Meek sustain and low-Fury all-ins, Flash lets you reset a Bladesurge angle or escape his Slice and Dice engage.

playing.title: Track Fury, not just health
playing.detail: Once his Fury crosses 50, W becomes a three-hit 1.5s stun that strips shields and his Q heal doubles. Don't extend an even trade into that state — disengage and let it decay.

playing.title: Bait Cull the Meek first
playing.detail: It's only a 7s cooldown so it's the easiest ability to force out. Wait until Ruthless Predator (16-8s) and Slice and Dice (16-10s) are both down before committing Q.

playing.title: Charge W into his combo
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces physical damage taken while charging — start it the moment he commits Slice and Dice or Ruthless Predator, not after you're already hit.

playing.title: Chain E into free Q resets
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's stun applies a Mark; landing Q on a Marked target refreshes its cooldown instantly, so stun-into-Q is your fastest damage window.

playing.title: Respect level 2-3 all-ins
playing.detail: Once he has W rank 2 plus E, the double-stun into dash is a real kill threat while your E is still on its 16s rank-1 cooldown. Don't overextend before level 3.

playing.title: Play around Dominus after 6
playing.detail: His R grants bonus health, AoE damage, and passive Fury generation. Once it's up, avoid extended brawls — burst him before it activates or disengage entirely.

playing.title: Stack passive before engaging
playing.detail: Build Ionian Fervor to 4 stacks off Q and E hits before committing so your attack speed scaling outpaces his raw slash damage in the extended trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and every win rate cited here are measured from live games on the current patch (1141-game sample for this matchup); the mechanical reasoning — Fury thresholds, cooldown windows, and trade timing — is our own tactical read, not part of the sampled data.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb Renekton’s skill damage with a well-timed [W]. Engage aggressively with 4 stacks [P] ready whenever Renekton’s skills are on cooldown.
